## Production Flagships & Studio Builds
- [Coffee & Cravings (Live Broadcast)](https://www.coffeeandcravings.shop/): Real-time artisan dining and QR table ordering platform with zero external runtime dependencies on native Node.js core, Upstash Redis KV, HMAC-SHA256 cryptographically signed QR table tokens across 6 dining tables, instant-chime Barista KDS, Razorpay & dynamic UPI payment verification, and 100% statutory DPDP Act 2023 compliance. Source: https://github.com/KNOWNASPRATYUSH/Coffee-cravings
- [India Fitness (Live Broadcast)](https://india-fitness.vercel.app/): High-performance digital athletics platform engineered with Next.js 15 (App Router), PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, and GSAP for locked 60FPS fluid transitions with zero cumulative layout shifts. Features personalized membership tiers, workout regimens, and interactive tools for Patna's premier gym destination across Sipara, Kurthaul & Sampatchak. Source: https://github.com/KNOWNASPRATYUSH/INDIA-FITNESS

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Frontend & Modern SSR**: React 19, Next.js 15, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, GSAP (GreenSock) 60FPS fluid motion, WCAG accessible semantics, zero CLS design.
- **Backend & Core Runtimes**: Zero-dependency Native Node.js core microservices (`http`, `crypto`, `fs`), Vercel Edge functions, idempotent webhook processing, real-time Kitchen Display Systems (KDS).
- **Data & In-Memory Caching**: Upstash Redis REST KV engine (<10ms global edge latency), Redis Sorted Sets, PostgreSQL relational databases, connection pooling.
- **Security & Cryptography**: HMAC-SHA256 request authentication, anti-replay tokens, replay-proof payment consumers, strict adherence to India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act 2023).
- **Web Performance**: Perfect Core Web Vitals (sub-second LCP, 0 CLS, minimal INP), asset compression, pre-rendered semantic HTML.
